numerical_failure.affected_api: jax._src.lax.lax (gradient rules for jax.lax.logistic, jax.lax.tanh, jax.lax.expm1 under accuracy HIGHEST)
numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Gradient of sigmoid/logistic computed as sigmoid(x)*(1-sigmoid(x)) is inaccurate when sigmoid(x) is close to 1 and causes the gradient to vanish for x > ~17 although it should only vanish at ~88; expm1 derivative computed as expm1(x)+1 is inaccurate for large negative x; tanh derivative computed as (1+tanh(x))(1-tanh(x)) suffers numerical issues when x is large.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Under AccuracyMode.HIGHEST, logistic gradient should be sigmoid(x)*sigmoid(-x), expm1 gradient should be exp(x), and tanh gradient should be 4*sigmoid(2x)*sigmoid(-2x).
trigger_conditions: x is large in magnitude for sigmoid/logistic (gradient vanishes for x > ~17 rather than ~88)
x is large in magnitude for tanh
x is large negative for expm1
oracle_clues: gradient should vanish only at ~88 for sigmoid
fix only changes behavior when accuracy is HIGHEST

numerical_characteristics.precision: HIGHEST accuracy mode; test uses float32 with atol from jtu.default_tolerance()[np.dtype(np.float32)] and rtol=0.0
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: sigmoid derivative vanishes for x > ~17 instead of ~88; expm1 derivative inaccurate for large negative x; tanh derivative inaccurate for large x; tests sweep x in [0,80) and [-80,80)
category_specific_evidence: PR body: sigmoid derivative sigmoid(x)*(1-sigmoid(x)) inaccurate when sigmoid(x) near 1, gradient vanished for x > ~17 though it should vanish only at ~88
PR body: expm1 derivative expm1(x)+1 inaccurate for large negative x, replaced with exp(x)
PR body: tanh derivative (1+tanh(x))(1-tanh(x)) replaced with 4*sigmoid(2x)*sigmoid(-2x)
PR body: changes only apply when accuracy is HIGHEST due to performance concerns
Diff: logistic jvp uses ans*logistic(-x) when accuracy is HIGHEST, else ans*(1-ans)
Diff: expm1 jvp uses exp(x) when accuracy is HIGHEST, else ans+1
Test testEvenFunctionGrads checks grad of logistic and tanh at x vs -x in float32 with HIGHEST accuracy
Test testExpm1Grad compares expm1 grad against exp grad over [-80,80) in float32 with HIGHEST accuracy
reproduction_risks: Behaviour differs by accuracy mode; default accuracy does not get the fix, so reproductions must set accuracy=HIGHEST
